skill.name: ai-video-generation
skill.description: Generate AI videos with Google Veo, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse, Wan, Grok and 40+ models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Veo 3.1, Veo 3, Seedance 2.0, HappyHorse 1.0, Wan 2.5, Grok Imagine Video, OmniHuman, Fabric, HunyuanVideo. Capabilities: text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-to-video, video editing, lipsync, avatar animation, video upscaling, foley sound. Use for: social media videos, marketing content, explainer videos, product demos, AI avatars. Triggers: video generation, ai video, text to video, image to video, veo, animate image, video from image, ai animation, video generator, generate video, t2v, i2v, ai video maker, create video with ai, runway alternative, pika alternative, sora alternative, kling alternative, seedance, happyhorse
skill.summary: Select AI video models and prepare inference.sh CLI workflows for generation, animation, editing, lipsync, audio, and upscaling.

security_audit.summary: The skill contains genuine external command and network behavior through documented belt and npx workflows. Most static backtick matches are Markdown fences or model identifiers, but command examples, third-party installation, remote image loading, and external media processing remain relevant risks.

remediation.issue: The skill directs agents to run networked belt commands that may consume paid services.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before login or generation, and disclose expected provider, data transfer, and cost.

remediation.issue: The installation examples use unpinned npx skill sources.
remediation.suggestion: Pin reviewed versions or immutable commits and direct users to verified installation documentation.

remediation.issue: Portraits, audio, and videos can be submitted to external inference providers.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users not to submit confidential or unauthorized media and document provider retention and privacy terms.

remediation.issue: The skill embeds an image from an external cloud host.
remediation.suggestion: Use a marketplace-hosted asset or a privacy-preserving image proxy.

content.user_title: Create AI Videos with Inference Models
content.value_statement: Choosing and invoking video models can require extensive platform knowledge. This skill provides model guidance and adaptable belt CLI workflows.
actual_capabilities: Recommends model identifiers for text, image, reference, avatar, and editing workflows.
Prepares belt CLI commands for hosted video generation applications.
Configures prompts, duration, resolution, generated audio, and media references.
Guides lipsync and talking-head generation from portrait and audio URLs.
Supports video upscaling, foley generation, and clip merging workflows.
limitations: Requires the belt CLI, an inference.sh account, authentication, and network access.
Model availability, output quality, processing time, and pricing depend on external providers.
Examples use remotely accessible media URLs and do not explain local file upload.
The skill does not verify consent, copyright, privacy, or acceptable-use compliance.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Clips
use_cases.description: Select a model and prepare short promotional video generation inputs for social channels.

use_cases.title: Animate Product Images
use_cases.description: Turn an existing product image into a controlled motion sequence with optional audio.

use_cases.title: Build Talking Avatars
use_cases.description: Combine authorized portrait and narration assets for lipsynced presenter videos.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Video Model
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend one model for a [duration] video showing [subject and action]. Prioritize [speed, quality, cost, or audio]. Explain the choice.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Text-to-Video Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a belt workflow for a [duration] [resolution] video. Scene: [description]. Include camera movement, lighting, style, and audio requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Reference Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Use [authorized image URL] to create a video with [motion]. Preserve [identity or product details]. Add [audio requirement] and recommend settings.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Step Video Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a pipeline that generates [scenes], adds [foley or narration], upscales output, and merges clips. State model choices, dependencies, privacy checks, and approval points.

output_examples.input: Create a five-second beach video quickly with synchronized ambient audio.
output_examples.output: Recommended Seedance 2.0 Fast for rapid generation with synchronized audio. The workflow specifies a five-second sunset scene and wave sounds.

output_examples.input: Animate an authorized product photograph with gentle camera motion.
output_examples.output: Recommended Wan 2.5 for image animation. The workflow preserves product shape, adds a slow orbit, and avoids changing labels.

output_examples.input: Create a talking presenter and improve the final video quality.
output_examples.output: Use OmniHuman with authorized portrait and narration assets, then process the result through the Topaz upscaler after user approval.

best_practices: Confirm the selected provider, estimated cost, and command before running any generation.
Use only media with documented consent and rights, especially portraits and voice recordings.
Start with short, low-resolution tests before requesting longer or higher-resolution outputs.
anti_patterns: Do not submit confidential media through public URLs or unknown hosting services.
Do not install unpinned skills or packages without reviewing their source and version.
Do not generate realistic people or voices without consent, attribution, and policy review.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does this skill generate videos locally?
faq.answer: No. It prepares belt commands that invoke hosted inference.sh applications.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install the reviewed belt CLI, create an account, authenticate, and ensure network access.

faq.question: Can it animate an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. Several documented models accept an image or reference URL for animation.

faq.question: Can it add audio or lipsync?
faq.answer: Yes. Documented workflows include generated audio, foley, talking avatars, and lipsync models.

faq.question: How should sensitive media be handled?
faq.answer: Use authorized assets, avoid confidential content, review provider terms, and obtain consent before external processing.
